title: The Religious Experience of Philip K. Dick by R. Crumb (1986)
summary: A comic adaptation by underground cartoonist R. Crumb documenting Philip K. Dick's spiritual visions and religious experiences during his later years, originally published in Weirdo #17 in 1986.
problem_solved: Documents and interprets Philip K. Dick's mystical religious experiences through artistic storytelling.
why_valuable: Provides a rare visual narrative of one of science fiction's most influential writers' spiritual journey, preserved through the distinctive artistic lens of R. Crumb.
